hn.title: Show HN: Wall Go – browser remake of a Devil's Plan 2 mini-game

quote.text: I don't seem to be able to select "hard" AI - is this just not implemented yet? It'd be nice to have a stronger AI, but I do realise that this is a lot easier said than done.
Played just to confirm that the yeti ate me :-D. Good times!
Works really well on desktop chrome! Good job!
